description: Agent Triage: submit the queue items with how each one ended, and the items received: each item with its id, its state (open, waiting, in progress or closed), its disposition (acted on, deferred, declined or merged as a duplicate), the recorded reason for a deferral or a decline, the item a duplicate was merged into, when a deferred item comes back and when it left the queue; and optionally the ids of every item received in the period, from intake. The signed report gives every item with its disposition and its status as acted_on, deferred, declined, duplicate, open, partly_recorded, undisposed or unconfirmed, every item received with its status as recorded or dropped, and counts the dispositions of each kind, the open items and the items dropped, and names items dropped silently: items received with no record, and items that left the queue with no disposition recorded; then deferrals and declines with no reason, duplicates linked to no item in the queue and deferrals with no date to come back, with the fix for each. This reads how every queue item ends: commitments marked done read against their delivery evidence are wever_commitment-closure-check, and where a refused or silent handed-off task goes is wever_handoff-failure-check. Verdict items_silently_dropped, disposition_partial, disposition_unrecorded or dispositions_recorded. POST /api/triage-disposition-check. Reads only the recorded queue items and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no item is captured, ranked, routed, escalated or closed and no queue is changed. Agent Triage reads how an agent sorts incoming work, from the item captured at intake to the disposition it ends with: it is not multi-agent coordination (how a group of agents organizes shared work, with its own escalation path, the wever_coordination checks; triage escalation is a single queue item breaching its threshold and moving up a tier, with its context attached), not the promises an agent has made (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; triage decides handling order and routing before any promise exists), not delegation (handing work off with authority, the wever_delegation checks; triage assigns incoming items to queues and owners, a sorting decision rather than a delegation) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the triage checks read a queue of items over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-triage-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-triage/.

items.description: Each queue item with how it ended.

disposition.description: Acted on, deferred, declined or merged as a duplicate.

duplicate_of.description: For a duplicate, the id of the item it was merged into.

id.description: The item id, such as q1.

reason.description: Why it was deferred or declined, as recorded.

revisit_at.description: For a deferral, when it comes back.

state.description: Open, waiting, in progress or closed.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

received.description: The ids of every item received in the period, from intake.

name: wever_triage-disposition-check
title: Triage disposition check
